The bagel has a golden-brown crust with visible green flecks (likely herbs or scallions) embedded in the dough. It features a distinct toroidal shape with a central hole, though the hole is partially obscured by the angle and the thickness of the roll. The surface appears slightly glossy but also textured with minor blistering.
